description: Land Title Settlement Department - Thudella, Ja-ela D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 512200
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land title registration under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding the determination of title to a specific parcel of land (Parcel No. 41, Block 04) with detailed land particulars including location, owner information, extent, and encumbrances. The content falls squarely under Land Gazettes as it deals with land registration, title determination, and property ownership matters.
